basic_info.description: Welcome to 280 28th Street, Unit 1, where modern elegance meets classic charm at the vibrant intersection of Sanchez and 28th Street in Noe Valley, San Francisco. This delightful 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home is ideal for those seeking a dynamic lifestyle.    Located on the back side of the building, this unit is very quiet and offers privacy with serene green views. The remodeled kitchen features a sleek, contemporary design perfect for culinary adventures. Hardwood floors and recessed lighting add to the inviting ambiance, while the functional layout ensures comfort.    Enjoy shared outdoor space for lounging or socializing. In-unit laundry hookups add convenience, complemented by new shared laundry facilities in the garage. With no shared walls, privacy is maximized, and the garage includes a deeded storage unit and EV charging parking.    Sanchez Street, a slow street, becomes your walker's paradise. Just moments from Church Street's cafes, boutiques, and nightlife, with nearby public transit for easy commuting.    Whether entertaining or enjoying quiet moments, Unit 1 offers an enriching lifestyle. Don't miss the opportunity to make this charming home yours and embrace the vibrant energy of Noe Valley living!
